headline: Tube Investments of India submits substantial acquisition disclosure for Shanthi Gears Limited
sum: Tube Investments of India Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition in Shanthi Gears Limited. The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure requirements for material shareholding movements.
detail: Tube Investments of India Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE, indicating a material acquisition of shares in Shanthi Gears Limited. This disclosure is a mandatory public notice required when an acquirer crosses specified shareholding thresholds. The filing establishes the legal foundation for the acquisition and triggers duties on the target company to convene a shareholder meeting and issue a detailed scheme or tender-offer document, depending on the structure chosen.
